baseline.text: 'no-housesBody1': "Houses come from the exact minute of birth — the sky's rotation, not the calendar. Without a time we compute a noon chart: every planet's sign is right — except sometimes the Moon, which can change sign within a day — and there is no horizon to hang houses on."
